How do I make a Playwright test wait for an API response?

Wait for the network response before clicking the button.

await page.waitForResponse(r => r.url().includes('/api/cart'));
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Checkout' }).click();

This is more reliable than a fixed timeout.

  • Wait for the network response.
  • Then click the Checkout button.
